message: Is there another brand promo taking over Gansevoort Plaza at the end of June? Something called Visit Morocco. These plaza takeovers keep happening and nobody tells the neighbors who's behind them.

I walk Canal west of Varick every day and crossing there is terrifying. Glad DOT reworked their plan, but please push for the quick fixes now, not in three years. And I don't think Grand Street is the right spot for a two-way bike lane.

I'm a parent at City-As-School and we'd love the board's backing for the Clarkson Street school street plan between Hudson and 7th Ave South: gates, planters, a little seating. Kids are out on that block every day and it needs to feel safer.
NADC Burger wants to serve beer and wine at 25 Cleveland Place, including out in the back yard. Those apartments behind it look right down onto that yard. Please no outdoor drinking back there.

These huge delivery warehouses the city wants to allow by special permit worry me. Please make sure the environmental review looks at the van and truck traffic on our side streets, we already have them double parked on every block.
an ice cream truck giveaway outside a clothing store for one sunday? fine by me as long as they clean up after
Dante on MacDougal wants tables on the sidewalk AND out in the street now. MacDougal is already jammed on weekend nights, you can barely walk past. Please keep an eye on how much space they take.

They want to tear down the old tenement at 139 Thompson and put up a six story building. It has a twin right next door and it's part of what makes the South Village feel the way it does. Has anyone independently confirmed it can't be saved?

I live at 142 W 4th and we're asking to put simple gates at the front entrances of our building and the one next door at 140. People keep sleeping and using in the doorways and it's not safe coming home at night. Hoping the board will support it.
Shifka at 324 Bowery is applying for beer and wine. Seems like a low key street food spot, just want to know what their closing hours will be.

My son has dyslexia and the Literacy Academy schools are the first public option I've found that actually teaches kids like him to read. Please support more public money for these schools and for reading instruction that's backed by evidence.
I use Access-A-Ride to get to my doctors and booking it is a nightmare. You can't change a trip the same day and the app barely works. Can the board push the MTA to make it more flexible?
Opposed to the dispensary planned for 66 Jane Street. It's a little 1849 row house on a residential block, and the address they're using isn't even where the actual storefront is.
Dagmar has been a fine neighbor as far as I can tell, but staying open until midnight now? That's a big jump from closing at 9.
Really glad to hear 30 Thompson Street will be permanently affordable co-ops. How will the lottery work, and do people from the neighborhood get any preference?
that dispensary has been fine. no lines, no trouble. support the renewal

There's a plan for a rooftop addition and rear extension at 739 Washington St. I'm in the building behind it. How deep are they digging the basement? I'm worried about our foundation during construction.
A 20 foot shower on Gansevoort Plaza for a shampoo brand?? In March? Not sure what the point is but please make sure it doesn't flood the cobblestones or block people walking through.
11 Howard is changing hands again and needs a new liquor license. The lounge has had some loud nights. Will the new owners keep the same hours and rules?

The cafe at 240 Mulberry between Prince and Spring wants a full liquor license instead of just beer and wine. It's a coffee and pastry place, why does it need cocktails? Feels like it's slowly turning into a bar.
As a public school parent downtown I'm horrified the city is letting ICE agents into schools. Kids need to feel safe in class. Please speak out against this.
We need B-HEARD everywhere. Mental health 911 calls should get social workers and EMTs, not police. Please push the city to expand it to all of Manhattan.
Another weed shop proposed at 224 Varick Street? There are already several within a few blocks. I'm against it.
The Flynnstoned dispensary application at 388 West Street keeps changing names and owners. Who actually owns this thing? Please look closely before anyone says yes.
Boqueria on Spring St wants dining in the roadway. Spring is narrow and delivery trucks already can't get through. Please say no.
I own Alta Dispensary on Kenmare Street. We've been open for over a year without complaints, and I'd really appreciate the board's support for our license renewal.
The pot shop up the block has been totally fine, no smell, no crowds out front. ok with renewing them.
Shosh on Greenwich Avenue wants a full bar license now. It's a small, quiet plant-based place. I don't object as long as it stays a restaurant and not a late night spot.
Cornelia Street is so narrow, how can Aperitivo di Palma put tables out in the roadway there? Fire trucks have to get through.

The state wants to make it easier for dispensaries to get waivers to open close to schools and churches. That's a bad idea. Please tell the Office of Cannabis Management to keep the distance rules strong.

The metal barricades they use to close Washington Square Park every night are ugly and loud. They get dragged around at midnight and then left lying on the paths all day. Can Parks come up with something better?
Crossing Canal at Washington St to get to Canal Park, the walk light is timed terribly and you get stuck on the island with cars flying by. Please ask DOT to fix the timing.
Yes to new Citi Bike docks on Sixth Ave between 9th and 10th and on Clarkson St. Also please move the Lafayette station north closer to Jersey Street like people asked for before.
Cafe Cluny is adding 26 outdoor seats on both West 4th and West 12th. That corner is a quiet residential spot and 26 seats is a lot.
Who is setting up the 'Runner' installation in the 14th Street plaza for most of June? Three weeks is a long time to lose a public plaza.

The Gansevoort Square plan still hands most of that public land to the Whitney and gives housing a sliver. And the whole process has been behind closed doors. We need way more affordable units there and a real public say.
81 Spring wants to add a second flag on the Crosby Street side plus new paint. Crosby is a quieter block with trees, the one flag on Spring seems like enough.
fine with the cafe keeping its sidewalk tables, it's part of the street
There's going to be a pop-up shop at 437 Broadway with lines on the sidewalk for over two weeks? Broadway between Grand and Howard is already a crush. Please make them stick to reservations.
Google wants a catering liquor license for the 12th floor terrace at 550 Washington. Are there going to be parties out there at night? Sound carries a long way over the highway.
I take the bus down Sixth Ave every day and I want a real bus lane. But don't take away the stops at Broome and at 12th Street, a lot of older riders depend on them.

The delivery trucks on my block are out of control, double parked all day and blocking the bike lane. If DOT's microhub pilot can cut that down, great, but please put the hubs somewhere that doesn't eat up sidewalk.
Cheers at 13th and University wants a tavern license? That corner already gets loud with the student crowd. Please hear from residents before this goes anywhere.
Shmone on West 8th wants to take over the storefront next door at 63. More seats means more noise on that block. I'd like to know about hours and whether there'll be music.
Prada is closing sidewalks and curbs on Mercer, Broadway and Prince for an evening party at 575 Broadway. Mercer St residents shouldn't lose their sidewalk for a store event.
Please support 20 mph speed limits across the whole neighborhood under Sammy's Law. Drivers race down Seventh Ave South and Varick. Slower speeds save lives.
Finally something going up on the empty lot at 144 Spring St. Concrete made to look like cast iron, though? I'd rather see something honest that fits the block.
Since Beth Israel closed, the ER at Bellevue is overwhelmed. I waited 9 hours there last month. The city needs to put more money into Bellevue, especially for psychiatric emergencies.
Byredo wants to close the curb on Wooster for a Friday night party with a DJ. Wooster between Broome and Spring is people's homes. A DJ outside is a no from me.
the diamond plate over the vault at 102 Greene was put in without approval and it looks like a construction site. other buildings did proper reproductions, they should too
Heard C+C Coffee + Cocktails on 9th Ave pulled their request for outdoor seating. If it comes back I'd like a chance to speak on it.
I'm a teacher and my training never covered how kids actually learn to read. Please support the state funding to build the science of reading into teacher prep and certification.
I watched masked ICE agents grab someone outside the federal courthouse at 201 Varick on my way to work. Nobody could tell who they were. They should have to show their faces and badges.
A dispensary at 11 West 8th Street? That building is almost all apartments. Please oppose it.
What's going into 263 Bleecker? I saw a notice for a wine license under the name Charlie Boy. Neighbors would like to hear more before anything is approved.
If the city is building housing on public land at Gansevoort it should be 100% affordable. We already lost so much housing in the Google rezoning deal.
My daughter's second grade class has 27 kids. The class size law is supposed to fix this but the DOE keeps stalling. Please push them for a real multi-year plan.
I volunteer with the Bedford and Grove open street outside PS 3. These streets are where our kids play and neighbors actually meet. Please support keeping open streets going all over the district.
The gelato place wants a few tables out in the roadway. Honestly it's a lovely spot, I'm for it.
Mighty Quinn's on Greenwich Ave has been there for ten years with no problems. If this is just paperwork on who owns it, no objection.
Angelika wants a full bar license for the theater on Houston? I'm fine with it, it's a movie house, not a club.
A popsicle bar and an ice sculpture for a lip balm brand sounds fun honestly. Just make sure they pick up all the sticks and wrappers.
The Zaza dispensary on East 11th is spread across two separate buildings and wants an exception to the distance rules. Please deny it.
Every dispensary notice we see seems to have a different owner name or address. The state needs to fix how communities get notified so people can't front for someone else.

Hi! Edible Schoolyard NYC is bringing back MacDougal Street Mambo in June on MacDougal between Prince and Houston. It's a great day for families and helps fund school gardens. We'd love the board's support again.
Four days on Gansevoort Plaza for a brand they won't even name, with a light show? How are neighbors supposed to have an opinion on that.
The free Beacon afterschool program at City-As-School is the only reason I can keep working full time. Please fight to keep its funding.
The church at 232 W 11th St wants to put a garbage bin enclosure out front. Better than bags piled on the curb, as long as it doesn't squeeze the sidewalk.
Please support the state bill that would give local communities a real say over dispensaries within 500 feet of a school.
airstream trailer and photo booth on gansevoort plaza for four days in july for some phone brand. again? the plaza isn't a showroom
I'm rent stabilized and another 4 to 7 percent would push me out of an apartment I've lived in for 20 years. Please tell the Rent Guidelines Board to freeze rents.
Ubani Bistro at 259 Bleecker wants a DJ, live music and sidewalk tables? I live upstairs. This stretch of Bleecker is residential, not a club strip.

West 3rd between LaGuardia and Mercer is a mess again: speeding cars, people parking where pedestrians should be. We need a street design that works on its own without a cop standing there every night.
Citi Bike e-bike fees have gotten ridiculous, a 20 minute ride costs more than the subway. Please support making it cheaper, especially for lower income riders.
Banana Republic on Broadway wants a bottle club license?? For a clothing store? what is that even about
My kid goes to Lower Manhattan Community Middle School at 26 Broadway. Expanding it into a 6-12 school would finally give downtown families a strong high school option. Please support it.
8 sidewalk seats for a small Italian place? That's reasonable. Fine with me.

I run a small cafe with one row of two-person tables against the wall. Now the city wants a full barrier around them, which takes up more sidewalk than the tables do. Could the board ask DOT to drop that for setups like ours?
Negril wants a full liquor license at 70 W 3rd. It's a big space. Will there be DJs or late hours? West 3rd is already party central on weekends.
The Park Service quietly dropped the T and the Q from the Stonewall monument's description. That's erasing trans people from their own history. Please speak up.
Blind Tiger at Bleecker and Jones wants sidewalk tables. That corner gets packed. Is there enough room left for strollers and wheelchairs?
The TRESemme event at 216 Lafayette expects up to 900 people a day for four days, with a line down the sidewalk. Lafayette between Kenmare and Spring can't handle that.
Since Beth Israel closed, ambulances take forever and the Northwell ER in the Village is swamped. Someone needs to track what services we actually lost and where people are going now.
Epistrophy on Mott wants 14 roadway seats AND a waiver on the fire lane. Mott is already narrow. If an ambulance can't reach our building, what then?
Two restaurants next to each other want sidewalk cafes. The sidewalk is pretty wide there, I think it's fine.
I'm the owner of weedkraft, opening at 112 Christopher Street. It's a family business, the lease is signed, and I'd be grateful for the board's support.
The old garage at 160 W 10th St is being turned into apartments with a rooftop addition. The front restoration sounds nice, but how tall is the addition going to be?
The renovation at 73 Washington Place has been going on since 2015. Now they want more time? When will it ever be finished?
Replacing the terracotta cornice at 70 Fifth Ave with a lighter material. If it matches and it's safer I'm for it, those cracks have been worrying.
City Planning keeps changing the zoning text without telling anyone, and the plans for 5 West 13th don't even add up. Please demand a public record of every change.
75 Morton lost its performing arts teacher and kids who want to audition for arts high schools have nothing now. Please help bring the program back.
That travel agency themed dispensary has been no trouble at all. Renew it.
a restaurant on university place wants 12 sidewalk seats. fine.
Glad 248 W 12th wants to put back the original masonry lintels instead of those metal caps. Good.
My mother's home attendant works 24 hour shifts and barely sleeps. Please support the No More 24 bill, it isn't safe for workers or for patients.
No issues with the sushi place on Greenwich keeping its roadway setup.
Saw a liquor license notice for 555 Greenwich St. Who's the operator? Hudson Square is quiet at night and we'd like it to stay that way.
ice cream newsstand at Astor Place for 3 days from Tillamook. sure, as long as the regular food stand there doesn't get pushed out
The nonprofit-run cannabis store does a lot of good and runs a clean shop. I support their renewal.
Sant Ambroeus wants roadway dining on West 4th. Is there even room left for a fire truck?
After the January blizzard half the docks were buried for weeks and Citi Bike still charged full price. Lyft owes members the two-week credit.
I bike up Lafayette to Astor Place every day and a two-way protected lane all the way up would be great. Please support DOT's plan, just make sure loading zones are thought through.
A two-way bike lane on Grand Street would wreck deliveries for the shops there. DOT should show the whole plan publicly before anything gets approved.
The art piece about homelessness coming to Petrosino Square sounds really meaningful. Happy to see it there.
The new penthouse planned for 43 Bleecker is huge and totally visible from the street. It was supposed to be a modest addition. Please oppose.
The rats on my block are out of control, especially around restaurant trash at night. We need real enforcement and abatement, not just signs.
Port Authority is putting anchors under the sidewalk along Canal between Hudson and Varick for a Holland Tunnel flood barrier. How long will the sidewalk be torn up?
Rug store pop-up needs the curb lane for loading for a few days. no problem.
Carmine Street Beers is back again wanting to serve in their backyard. That yard is surrounded by our bedroom windows. Same answer as last time: no.
The Eternal Flame piece for Scott Burton at the AIDS Memorial on St. Vincent's Triangle sounds beautiful. I support it.
I work at the Public Theater on Lafayette, and we're updating our liquor license to cover how the building's spaces are used now. We'd appreciate the board's support.
Our public hospital takes care of everyone no matter what. Please ask the city and state to put more money into it in this year's budget.
Will the 24 affordable co-ops at 285 Hudson Street actually stay affordable? I'd like to hear how resale prices are capped.
The old church rectory at 79 Christopher wants a rooftop addition, a taller chimney and railings. It's a tiny 16 foot wide house and this will change it a lot.
That restaurant on Sullivan has had sidewalk tables for years with no issues. fine with it.
Olio e Piu's roadway setup on Greenwich Ave makes that corner super tight for turning cars. not a fan.
I'm an immigrant and a neighbor. Please make clear this city keeps its sanctuary laws and doesn't let NYPD help ICE.
Olio e Piu's sidewalk cafe got turned down by the state and now they're trying again. The sidewalk at 3 Greenwich Ave is crammed already.
a bar at 45 Renwick?? Renwick is a tiny residential street. no.
151 Grand's approval expired and they want it back. Fine, but the paint color in the drawings looks pitch black, not the dark green they showed us.
Please support extending the Lafayette two-way bike lane north to Astor Place and painting one on Broadway. Biking from SoHo up to Union Square right now is scary.
Casa D'Angelo on Mulberry wants a sidewalk table setup that's only two feet wide. That's going to block wheelchairs.
We're replacing the worn out 11th floor windows at 55 Bethune St. The new ones will look basically the same from the street. Hoping for a quick ok.
Canal Street sidewalks are impossible to walk on. Please support DOT's redesign but push for wider sidewalks and a safe crosstown bike route.
A beauty brand event in a studio on 8th street needs the curb for loading. Everything is indoors, no lines. fine.
11 Howard wants to add a ground floor restaurant to its hotel liquor license. The Blond has had noise issues, please check before approving.
The flagpole at 594 Broadway would drill right into the stone. Can't they mount it in a mortar joint like everyone else?
New Thai bistro at 51 W 8th applying for beer and wine. Welcome to the block! Just please no outdoor music.
Deans at Sixth Ave and King St wants a full liquor license. King is a quiet residential street, please keep the entrance and any noise on Sixth.
